attributes.action: Let childcare & education settings keep adrenaline for children with allergies
attributes.additional_details: It is unfair that access to emergency allergy medication depends on where a child is. Schools can buy spare adrenaline devices, but many nurseries, childminders, colleges, clubs and youth groups cannot. Families worry; staff may have to respond without spare medication. We ask the Government to amend MHRA regulations so non-school education, childcare and youth settings can choose to buy and hold spare adrenaline devices, including auto-injectors, nasal sprays and future approved devices.
attributes.background: Amend the regulations so non-school childcare and education settings—including nurseries, childminders, after-school and holiday clubs, and post16 colleges—can buy and keep spare adrenaline devices, with suitable safeguards and training.

rejection.details:
We already have two petitions open which cover what you are asking for. You may wish to sign one or both of them:

Amend law to extend statutory guidance on emergency injectors to early years
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/768952

Allow clubs and organisations to purchase & hold spare adrenaline auto-injectors
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/783433
